name: B10-0251/2025 (S&D) – Violations of religious freedom in Tibet
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on violations of religious freedom in Tibet
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and asking China to stop persecuting religious people in Tibet. It asks China to keep its own constitutional promise of religious freedom, to separate state and religion, and to stop discrimination against religious and ethnic minorities. It also asks China to say where Gedhun Choekyi Nyima, recognised as the Panchen Lama in 1995, and his family are, and to let them return safely to Tibet.

- Nothing changes in law; Parliament only states its position and makes requests to China.
- The requests concern China's treatment of Tibetan Buddhists and other religious minorities.
- Parliament sends the resolution to European Union and Chinese authorities; no further action is set out.
